name: La Casa de las Madres
description: Emergency shelter, counseling, support groups, and housing support
fullDescription: La Casa de las Madres provides support services for women, teens, and children affected by domestic violence in San Francisco, offering 24/7 adult and teen hotlines, confidential emergency shelter, counseling, support groups, and housing assistance.
whatTheyOffer:
- 24/7 adult and teen crisis lines
- Text support line
- Confidential emergency shelter for women and children (stays up to 8 weeks)
- Individual counseling and support groups
- Drop-in Counseling Center (walk-in or appointment, Mon-Fri 8:30am-5pm)
- Safety planning and risk assessment
- Safe housing and permanent supportive housing services
- Community prevention education
howToGetIt:
1. Call 24-hour adult crisis line: 877-503-1850
2. Teen crisis line: 877-923-0700
3. Text line: 415-200-3575
4. Business office / Drop-in Counseling Center: 415-503-0500
5. Speak with a trained advocate and receive safety planning support
6. Access shelter and services as needed
keywords: La Casa de las Madres, San Francisco, crisis line, teen hotline, emergency shelter, counseling, support groups, drop-in counseling center, supportive housing, 877-503-1850
